```{r setup, class.source = "fold-hide"}
wrap_2lines <- function(x, width = 35) {
  vapply(x, function(s) {
    s <- as.character(s)
    if (nchar(s) <= width) return(s)
    cut <- stringr::str_locate_all(substr(s, 1, width), " ")[[1]]
    cut <- if (nrow(cut) == 0) width else max(cut[, 1])
    line1 <- stringr::str_trim(substr(s, 1, cut))
    rest  <- stringr::str_trim(substr(s, cut + 1, nchar(s)))
    if (nchar(rest) > width) rest <- paste0(substr(rest, 1, width - 1), "…")
    paste(line1, rest, sep = "\n")
  }, FUN.VALUE = character(1))
}
```

```{r}
counts <- read_tsv("/shares/rheumatologie.usz/Gino/HMEC_second_run/results_rnaseq/star_salmon/salmon.merged.gene_counts.tsv", col_types = cols())

gene_col <- colnames(counts)[2]
counts_mat <- as.matrix(counts[, -c(1, 2)])
rownames(counts_mat) <- counts[[gene_col]]
storage.mode(counts_mat) <- "numeric"

meta <- read_excel(here::here("data", "HMEC_RNAseq", "HMEC_second_run_sample_group_ID.xlsx")) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, Group) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Sample %in% colnames(counts_mat)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(match(Sample, colnames(counts_mat)))

counts_mat <- counts_mat[, meta$Sample, drop = FALSE]
rownames(meta) <- meta$Sample
group <- factor(meta$Group)

y <- DGEList(counts = counts_mat, samples = meta)
y$samples$group <- group
```

```{r pca samples, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
logcpm <- cpm(y, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)
pr <- prcomp(t(logcpm), scale. = FALSE)

pve <- (pr$sdev^2) / sum(pr$sdev^2) * 100

pca_df <- data.frame(
  Sample = rownames(meta),
  Group = factor(meta$Group, levels = c("HC", "HF")),
  PC1 = pr$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pr$x[, 2]
)

ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, fill = Group, label = Sample)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3, stroke = 0.4, color = "black") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.size = 0.25
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_cols) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.18)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.18)) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pve[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pve[2], 1), "%)")
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

```{r, fig.height=4, fig.width=4}
levels(group)

group <- relevel(group, ref = "HC")
y$samples$group <- group

design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group)
colnames(design) <- levels(group)
design

contrast <- makeContrasts(
  HF_vs_HC = HF - HC,
  levels = design
)

y <- estimateDisp(y, design)
plotBCV(y)

fit <- glmQLFit(y, design)

qlf <- glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrast)

res <- topTags(qlf, n = Inf)$table
head(res)
```

```{r export differential expression results}
res_export <- res %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    metric = logFC * -log10(PValue),
    significance = dplyr::case_when(
      FDR < 0.2 & logFC > 0.5 ~ "Increased",
      FDR < 0.2 & logFC < -0.5 ~ "Decreased",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    ),
    comparison = "HF_vs_HC"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(FDR, dplyr::desc(abs(logFC)))

res_signif_export <- res_export %>%
  dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.2, abs(logFC) > 0.5) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(metric))

write.csv(
  res_export,
  file = file.path(output_dir_data, "HMEC_DE_results_HF_vs_HC_all_genes.csv"),
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  res_signif_export,
  file = file.path(output_dir_data, "HMEC_DE_results_HF_vs_HC_significant_genes.csv"),
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r reorder_GO_by_pvalue}
reorder_GO_by_pvalue <- function(enrichGO_result) {
  go_results <- enrichGO_result@result
  go_results_sorted <- go_results[order(go_results$p.adjust), ]
  enrichGO_result@result <- go_results_sorted
  return(enrichGO_result)
}
```

```{r ranked_genes}
res$metric <- res$logFC*-log10(res$PValue)
res$gene <- rownames(res)
entrezid <- bitr(res$gene, fromType="SYMBOL", toType="ENTREZID", OrgDb="org.Hs.eg.db", drop = TRUE)
res <- merge(res, entrezid, by.x = "gene", by.y = "SYMBOL", all.x = TRUE)
res[duplicated(res$metric) | duplicated(res$metric, fromLast = TRUE),]
res <- res[!duplicated(res$metric), ]
ranked_genes <- res[!is.na(res$ENTREZID), ]
genelist <- ranked_genes$metric
names(genelist) <-ranked_genes$ENTREZID
genelist <- genelist[order(genelist, decreasing = T)]
```

```{r heatmap top 20 up down prepare, fig.height=6, fig.width=6}
top_up <- res |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(metric)) |>
  dplyr::slice(1:20)

top_down <- res |>
  dplyr::arrange(metric) |>
  dplyr::slice(1:20)

genes_up <- top_up$gene
genes_down <- top_down$gene

genes_up
genes_down

genes_ordered <- c(genes_up, genes_down)
genes_ordered <- genes_ordered[genes_ordered %in% rownames(logCPM)]

mat_metric <- logCPM[genes_ordered, , drop = FALSE]

group_heatmap <- factor(meta[colnames(mat_metric), "Group", drop = TRUE], levels = c("HC", "HF"))
ord <- order(group_heatmap)

mat_metric_ord <- mat_metric[, ord, drop = FALSE]
mat_metric_ord_z <- t(scale(t(mat_metric_ord)))
mat_metric_ord_z[is.na(mat_metric_ord_z)] <- 0

annotation_col_ord <- data.frame(
  Group = group_heatmap[ord],
  row.names = colnames(mat_metric_ord)
)

ha_hmec <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Group = annotation_col_ord$Group,
  col = list(Group = group_cols),
  annotation_name_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold")
)

Heatmap(
  mat_metric_ord_z,
  name = "Z-score",
  top_annotation = ha_hmec,
  col = heat_cols,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 7),
  row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),
  column_title = "Top 20 up and top 20 down genes",
  column_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold")
)
```

```{r classify_terms}
classify_terms <- function(df) {
  df$sign <- ifelse(df$NES > 0, "activated", "suppressed")
  return(df)
}
```

```{r GSEA_GO_emapplot, fig.height=10, fig.width=20}
GSEA_GO@result <- classify_terms(GSEA_GO@result)

activated_terms <- subset(GSEA_GO@result, sign == "activated")
suppressed_terms <- subset(GSEA_GO@result, sign == "suppressed")

GSEA_GO_activated <- GSEA_GO
GSEA_GO_activated@result <- activated_terms
GSEA_GO_activated <- pairwise_termsim(GSEA_GO_activated)

GSEA_GO_suppressed <- GSEA_GO
GSEA_GO_suppressed@result <- suppressed_terms
GSEA_GO_suppressed <- pairwise_termsim(GSEA_GO_suppressed)

p1 <- emapplot(GSEA_GO_activated, showCategory = 50, size_category = 0.7, min_edge = 0.25) +
  ggtitle("Activated Terms") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5))

p2 <- emapplot(GSEA_GO_suppressed, showCategory = 50, size_category = 0.7, min_edge = 0.25) +
  ggtitle("Suppressed Terms") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5))

combined_plot <- p1 | p2
print(combined_plot)
```

```{r make gsea barplot helper}
make_gsea_barplot <- function(gsea_obj, label_width = 40, top_n = 10, base_size = 11) {
  if (is.null(gsea_obj) || nrow(gsea_obj@result) == 0) return(NULL)

  gsea_bar_df <- gsea_obj@result %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(NES), !is.na(p.adjust), p.adjust < 0.05)

  if (nrow(gsea_bar_df) == 0) return(NULL)

  gsea_bar_df <- gsea_bar_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(score = -log10(p.adjust) * sign(NES))

  gsea_bar_df_pos <- gsea_bar_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(NES > 0) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(NES)) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n)

  gsea_bar_df_neg <- gsea_bar_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(NES < 0) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(NES) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n)

  gsea_bar_df_plot <- dplyr::bind_rows(gsea_bar_df_pos, gsea_bar_df_neg)

  if (nrow(gsea_bar_df_plot) == 0) return(NULL)

  gsea_bar_df_plot$Description <- factor(
    gsea_bar_df_plot$Description,
    levels = gsea_bar_df_plot$Description[order(gsea_bar_df_plot$NES)]
  )

  L <- unname(quantile(abs(gsea_bar_df_plot$score), probs = 0.80, na.rm = TRUE))
  if (!is.finite(L) || L == 0) L <- max(abs(gsea_bar_df_plot$score), na.rm = TRUE)

  ggplot(gsea_bar_df_plot, aes(x = Description, y = NES, fill = score)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.9) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#004C8C",
      mid = "white",
      high = "#A63A2A",
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = c(-L, L),
      oob = scales::squish,
      name = expression(-log[10](adj.~p) %*% sign(NES))
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) wrap_2lines(x, width = label_width)) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Normalized enrichment score (NES)") +
    theme_bw(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
      plot.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_colorbar(
      barwidth = grid::unit(6, "cm"),
      barheight = grid::unit(0.3, "cm"),
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust = 0.5
    ))
}
```

```{r reorder_GO_by_NES}
reorder_GO_by_NES <- function(enrichGO_result) {
  go_results <- enrichGO_result@result
  go_results_sorted <- go_results[order(desc(go_results$NES)), ]
  enrichGO_result@result <- go_results_sorted
  return(enrichGO_result)
}
```

```{r default_labeller}
default_labeller <- function(n) {
    function(str){
        str <- gsub("_", " ", str)
        ep_str_wrap(str, n)
    }
}
```

```{r barplot.enrichResult}
barplot.enrichResult <- function (height, x = "Count", color = "p.adjust", showCategory = 8, 
  font.size = 12, title = "", label_format = 30, ...) 
{
  object <- height
  colorBy <- match.arg(color, c("pvalue", "p.adjust", "qvalue"))
  if (x == "geneRatio" || x == "GeneRatio") {
    x <- "GeneRatio"
  }
  else if (x == "count" || x == "Count") {
    x <- "Count"
  }
  df <- fortify(object, showCategory = showCategory, by = x, 
    ...)
  if (colorBy %in% colnames(df)) {
    p <- ggplot(df, aes_string(x = x, y = "Description", 
      fill = colorBy)) + theme_dose(font.size) + set_enrichplot_color(type = "fill", 
      name = color)
  }
  else {
    p <- ggplot(df, aes_string(x = x, y = "Description", 
      fill = "Description")) + theme_dose(font.size) + 
      theme(legend.position = "none")
  }
  label_func <- default_labeller(label_format)
  if (is.function(label_format)) {
    label_func <- label_format
  }
  p + geom_col() + scale_y_discrete(labels = label_func) + 
    ggtitle(title) + ylab(NULL)
}
```

```{r ep_str_wrap}
ep_str_wrap <- function(string, width) {
    x <- gregexpr(' ', string)
    vapply(seq_along(x),
           FUN = function(i) {
               y <- x[[i]]
               n <- nchar(string[i])
               len <- (c(y,n) - c(0, y)) ## length + 1
               idx <- len > width
               j <- which(!idx)
               if (length(j) && max(j) == length(len)) {
                   j <- j[-length(j)]
               }
               if (length(j)) {
                   idx[j] <- len[j] + len[j+1] > width
               }
               idx <- idx[-length(idx)] ## length - 1
               start <- c(1, y[idx] + 1)
               end <- c(y[idx] - 1, n)
               words <- substring(string[i], start, end)
               paste0(words, collapse="\n")
           },
           FUN.VALUE = character(1)
    )
}
```

```{r hmec gene program definitions}
format_p_label <- function(p) {
  if (length(p) == 0 || is.na(p)) return("NA")
  dplyr::case_when(
    p < 0.0001 ~ "****",
    p < 0.001  ~ "***",
    p < 0.01   ~ "**",
    p < 0.05   ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ sprintf("%.4f", p)
  )
}

format_p_fontface <- function(p) {
  if (length(p) == 0 || is.na(p)) return("plain")
  dplyr::case_when(
    p < 0.05 ~ "bold",
    TRUE ~ "plain"
  )
}

collapse_duplicate_genes <- function(mat) {
  rowsum_mat <- rowsum(mat, group = rownames(mat), reorder = FALSE)
  gene_n <- table(rownames(mat))[rownames(rowsum_mat)]
  sweep(rowsum_mat, 1, as.numeric(gene_n), "/")
}
```

```{r hmec gene symbol alias mapping}
# Keep the expression matrix unchanged, and instead resolve gene lists to the
# symbols/aliases actually present in logcpm_scores_gene.

manual_gene_alias_map <- c(
  "ATP5F1A" = "ATP5A1",
  "ATP5F1B" = "ATP5B",
  "ATP5F1C" = "ATP5C1",
  "ATP5F1D" = "ATP5D",
  "ATP5F1E" = "ATP5E",
  "ATP5PB"  = "ATP5F1",
  "ATP5ME"  = "ATP5I",
  "ATP5PF"  = "ATP5J2",
  "ATP5PO"  = "ATP5O",
  "ATP5MF"  = "ATP5J2",
  "ATP5PD"  = "ATP5H",
  "ATP5MG"  = "ATP5L",
  "ATP5IF1" = "ATPIF1",
  "MACROH2A1" = "H2AFY",
  "NOP53" = "GLTSCR2",
  "ANTKMT" = "C10orf2",
  "KGD4" = "MRPS36",
  "ATPSCKMT" = "CKMT2",
  "ETFRF1" = "LYRM5",
  "PRXL2C" = "AAED1",
  "CSKMT" = "METTL12",
  "MLDHR" = "C16orf70",
  "PIMREG" = "FAM64A",
  "JPT1" = "HN1"
)

get_symbol_alias_candidates <- function(gene) {
  out <- character(0)

  by_symbol <- suppressMessages(
    AnnotationDbi::select(
      org.Hs.eg.db,
      keys = gene,
      keytype = "SYMBOL",
      columns = c("SYMBOL", "ALIAS")
    )
  )

  if (nrow(by_symbol) > 0) {
    out <- c(out, by_symbol$SYMBOL, by_symbol$ALIAS)
  }

  by_alias <- suppressMessages(
    AnnotationDbi::select(
      org.Hs.eg.db,
      keys = gene,
      keytype = "ALIAS",
      columns = c("SYMBOL", "ALIAS")
    )
  )

  if (nrow(by_alias) > 0) {
    out <- c(out, by_alias$SYMBOL, by_alias$ALIAS)
  }

  unique(stats::na.omit(as.character(out)))
}

resolve_gene_symbol <- function(gene, matrix_genes) {
  if (gene %in% matrix_genes) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      original_gene = gene,
      resolved_gene = gene,
      mapping_status = "direct",
      map_source = "matrix rowname"
    ))
  }

  manual_hit <- unname(manual_gene_alias_map[gene])
  if (!is.na(manual_hit) && manual_hit %in% matrix_genes) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      original_gene = gene,
      resolved_gene = manual_hit,
      mapping_status = "mapped",
      map_source = "manual alias map"
    ))
  }

  candidates <- get_symbol_alias_candidates(gene)
  candidate_hits <- candidates[candidates %in% matrix_genes]

  if (length(candidate_hits) > 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      original_gene = gene,
      resolved_gene = candidate_hits[1],
      mapping_status = "mapped",
      map_source = "org.Hs.eg.db SYMBOL/ALIAS"
    ))
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    original_gene = gene,
    resolved_gene = NA_character_,
    mapping_status = "missing",
    map_source = NA_character_
  )
}

resolve_gene_vector <- function(genes, matrix_genes) {
  purrr::map_dfr(unique(genes), resolve_gene_symbol, matrix_genes = matrix_genes)
}

program_gene_map <- purrr::imap_dfr(program_list, function(genes, program) {
  resolve_gene_vector(genes, rownames(logcpm_scores_gene)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(program = program, .before = 1)
})
```

```{r hmec program scores}
make_program_score <- function(mat, genes) {
  gene_map <- resolve_gene_vector(genes, rownames(mat))

  genes_present <- gene_map %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(resolved_gene)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(resolved_gene) %>%
    unique()

  if (length(genes_present) == 0) {
    out <- rep(NA_real_, ncol(mat))
    names(out) <- colnames(mat)
    return(out)
  }

  mat_sub <- mat[genes_present, , drop = FALSE]
  mat_z <- t(scale(t(mat_sub)))
  mat_z[!is.finite(mat_z)] <- 0

  colMeans(mat_z, na.rm = TRUE)
}

    make_program_score(logcpm_scores_gene, program_list[[nm]])[score_df$Sample]

    genes_mapped = paste(
      unique(paste0(original_gene[mapping_status == "mapped"], "->", resolved_gene[mapping_status == "mapped"])),
      collapse = ";"
    ),
    genes_missing_after_mapping = paste(original_gene[is.na(resolved_gene)], collapse = ";"),
```

```{r hmec score plotting functions}
plot_program_score <- function(df, score_col, title) {
  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(Sample, Group, score = dplyr::all_of(score_col)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(score))

  fit <- lm(score ~ Group, data = df)
  p_group <- broom::tidy(fit) %>%
    dplyr::filter(term == "GroupHF") %>%
    dplyr::pull(p.value)

  y_max <- max(df$score, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min <- min(df$score, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- y_max - y_min
  if (!is.finite(y_range) || y_range == 0) y_range <- 1

  ggplot(df, aes(x = Group, y = score, fill = Group)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.10, size = 1.5, shape = 21, stroke = 0.4, color = "black") +
    geom_segment(
      aes(x = 1, xend = 2, y = y_max + 0.10 * y_range, yend = y_max + 0.10 * y_range),
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 1.5,
      y = y_max + 0.16 * y_range,
      label = format_p_label(p_group),
      size = 5,
      fontface = format_p_fontface(p_group)
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_cols) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_min - 0.05 * y_range, y_max + 0.22 * y_range)) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = "Score") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

plot_gene_logcpm <- function(original_gene, resolved_gene = NULL) {
  if (is.null(resolved_gene)) {
    gene_map <- resolve_gene_symbol(original_gene, rownames(logcpm_scores_gene))
    resolved_gene <- gene_map$resolved_gene[1]
  }

  if (is.na(resolved_gene) || !(resolved_gene %in% rownames(logcpm_scores_gene))) {
    stop("Gene not found after alias mapping: ", original_gene)
  }

  gene_mat <- logcpm_scores_gene[resolved_gene, , drop = FALSE]
  gene_values <- as.numeric(gene_mat[1, ])

  df <- tibble::tibble(
    Sample = colnames(logcpm_scores_gene),
    gene = original_gene,
    resolved_gene = resolved_gene,
    logCPM = gene_values,
    Group = factor(meta[colnames(logcpm_scores_gene), "Group", drop = TRUE], levels = c("HC", "HF"))
  )

  fit <- lm(logCPM ~ Group, data = df)

  p_group <- broom::tidy(fit) %>%
    dplyr::filter(term == "GroupHF") %>%
    dplyr::pull(p.value)

  y_max <- max(df$logCPM, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min <- min(df$logCPM, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- y_max - y_min
  if (!is.finite(y_range) || y_range == 0) y_range <- 1

  plot_title <- if (original_gene == resolved_gene) {
    original_gene
  } else {
    paste0(original_gene, " (", resolved_gene, ")")
  }

  ggplot(df, aes(x = Group, y = logCPM, fill = Group)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.10, size = 1.5, shape = 21, stroke = 0.4, color = "black") +
    geom_segment(
      aes(x = 1, xend = 2, y = y_max + 0.10 * y_range, yend = y_max + 0.10 * y_range),
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 1.5,
      y = y_max + 0.16 * y_range,
      label = format_p_label(p_group),
      size = 5,
      fontface = format_p_fontface(p_group)
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_cols) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_min - 0.05 * y_range, y_max + 0.22 * y_range)) +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = NULL, y = "logCPM") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}
```

```{r hmec selected gene plots, fig.width=2.8, fig.height=3.7, warning=FALSE}
  tibble::tibble(
    Sample = colnames(logcpm_scores_gene),
    Group = factor(meta[colnames(logcpm_scores_gene), "Group", drop = TRUE], levels = c("HC", "HF")),
    gene = original_gene,
    resolved_gene = resolved_gene,
    logCPM = gene_values
  )
}) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_program_lookup, by = c("gene" = "original_gene"))

selected_gene_stats <- selected_gene_logcpm_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene, resolved_gene, program) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~ {
    if (nrow(.x) == 0 || dplyr::n_distinct(.x$Group) < 2) {
      return(tibble::tibble())
    }
    broom::tidy(lm(logCPM ~ Group, data = .x))
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(comparison = "HF_vs_HC") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(term) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

selected_gene_stats_group <- selected_gene_stats %>%
  dplyr::filter(term == "GroupHF") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p.value)

write.csv(
  selected_gene_logcpm_df,
  file = file.path(output_dir_data, "HMEC_selected_gene_logCPM_by_sample.csv"),
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  selected_gene_stats,
  file = file.path(output_dir_data, "HMEC_selected_gene_stats_HF_vs_HC_all_terms.csv"),
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  selected_gene_stats_group,
  file = file.path(output_dir_data, "HMEC_selected_gene_stats_HF_vs_HC_group_effect.csv"),
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(selected_genes_present))) {
  print(plot_gene_logcpm(
    original_gene = selected_genes_present$original_gene[i],
    resolved_gene = selected_genes_present$resolved_gene[i]
  ))
}
```

# Remove two samples

```{r}
keep_samples <- c("CZD12", "CZD13", "CZD15", "CZD19", "CZD22",  "CZD25",   "HT28",  "HT30",  "HT31",  "LV65",  "LV66",  "LV69", "LV72",  "LV75")

idx <- meta$Sample %in% keep_samples
meta_sub <- meta[idx, , drop = FALSE]
counts_sub <- counts_mat[, idx, drop = FALSE]

group <- factor(meta_sub$Group)
y2 <- DGEList(counts = counts_sub, samples = meta_sub)
y2$samples$group <- group

keep_genes <- filterByExpr(y2, group = group, min.count = 20)
y2 <- y2[keep_genes, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
y2 <- calcNormFactors(y2)

group <- relevel(group, ref = "HC")
y2$samples$group <- group

design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group)
colnames(design) <- levels(group)

contrast <- makeContrasts(HF_vs_HC = HF - HC, levels = design)

y2 <- estimateDisp(y2, design)
fit <- glmQLFit(y2, design)
qlf <- glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrast)

res2 <- topTags(qlf, n = Inf)$table
```

```{r volcano HF vs HC no CZD23 CZD27, fig.height=5, fig.width=4}
res2_df <- res2 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Gene = rownames(res2),
    significance = dplyr::case_when(
      FDR < 0.2 & logFC > 0.5 ~ "Increased",
      FDR < 0.2 & logFC < -0.5 ~ "Decreased",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    ),
    significance = factor(significance, levels = names(volcano_cols))
  )

n_h2  <- sum(meta_sub$Group == "HC")
n_hf2 <- sum(meta_sub$Group == "HF")

EnhancedVolcano(
  res2_df,
  lab = res2_df$Gene,
  x = "logFC",
  y = "FDR",
  labSize = 0,
  legendLabSize = 12,
  titleLabSize = 14,
  axisLabSize = 12,
  captionLabSize = 0,
  pointSize = 0.8,
  FCcutoff = 0.5,
  pCutoff = 0.2,
  ylim = c(0, 2),
  xlim = c(-3.75, 3.75),
  colAlpha = 1,
  drawConnectors = FALSE,
  ylab = bquote(-Log[10]~FDR),
  subtitle = NULL,
  title = paste0("HMEC
HF (n=", n_hf2, ") vs HC (n=", n_h2, ")
(no CZD23 and CZD27)"),
  colCustom = setNames(
    volcano_cols[as.character(res2_df$significance)],
    as.character(res2_df$significance)
  )
) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
